metas.name: Monster
metas.description: This true-crime anthology series delivers a multi-layered psychological study of individuals whose extreme actions shocked society.

metas.name: The Gentlemen
metas.description: When aristocratic Eddie inherits the family estate, he discovers that it's home to a huge weed empire, and its proprietors aren't going anywhere.

metas.name: Crew Girl
metas.description: After being disgraced by her father's financial fraud, a teen girl must escape with her mother to a small town where she ends up being the only female rower on the team at her new prep school.

metas.name: The Real Unforgotten
metas.description: Detectives reinvestigate the murder of Carol Morgan in the storeroom of her Bedfordshire corner shop in 1981 - re-examining the files, revisiting the crime scene, and looking for new witnesses as previously missed evidence points to a different theory.

metas.name: The Perfect Lie
metas.description: Four couples in a tight-knit group enjoy an extravagant lifestyle. When one of their villas burns down and a member dies, their web of lies begins to unravel.

metas.name: Death of the Pastor's Wife
metas.description: What happened to Mica Miller? This documentary series retraces her promising life, toxic marriage and the mysterious circumstances of her death.

metas.name: Mark Rober's CrunchLabs
metas.description: At CrunchLabs, Mark Rober transforms wild ideas into reality, blending engineering and outrageous fun for science adventures you'll never forget.

metas.name: Flack
metas.description: Robyn, an American publicist working for a cutthroat London PR company that represents troubled celebrities, is adept at keeping her clients' lives appearing in perfect order, while her own falls to pieces.

metas.name: Not a Stranger
metas.description: After giving birth, painter Funda put her career on hold to focus on her child. Ready to return to painting, she finally finds the nanny she has been searching for: Nazlı. But the mysterious and increasingly unsettling woman soon begins to disrupt the seemingly peaceful lives of Funda and her husband İlker. What begins as a simple employment arrangement develops into a dangerous psychological game in which desire, secrets and loyalty are put to the test.

metas.name: Sherlock
metas.description: In modern-day London, brilliant but eccentric detective Sherlock Holmes teams with war veteran Dr. John Watson to crack baffling crimes, outwit formidable foes, and aid Scotland Yard with razor-sharp deduction.
